# Recursive types through reserved refs, and forwarding intersections.
builder
reserve self
prim i integer
arr list self in=children
ucls node open - n=Node fwd=self
props node v:i,children?:list
reserve f
prim i2 integer in=again fwd=f
cls wrapper a:f,b:i in=Wrapper
top Tree node
top W wrapper
finish printonrewrite
print
rmind debug
print
